title: CitationRecord
description: Schema for a citation record linking a claim to a source. Stored in claims.jsonl (one JSON object per line).

citation_id.description: Unique identifier for this citation within the run. Format: cite-NNN.

source_id.description: References a source_id from sources.jsonl. Must point to an existing saved source record.

claim_text.description: The text being cited (short quote or paraphrase). Under 200 words for direct quotes.

claim_type.description: Type of claim. Facts require mandatory citation. Recommendations are author opinion.

location_in_report.description: Section or paragraph reference where this claim appears in the report.

additional_source_ids.description: Additional source IDs that support this claim.

quote_is_verbatim.description: Whether claim_text is a verbatim quote from the source.
